newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Equitable Banking debuts at 118 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Equitable Banking debuts at 118 pesos.

text.p: The Philippines' Equitable Banking Corp initial public offering (IPO) debuted on Thursday at 118 pesos, compared with an offering price of 113.30 pesos.
The country's ninth largest bank had offered 85,412,820 shares in its eagerly-awaited IPO, which had been trading at grey market prices of 120 to 125 pesos prior to the listing.
After the opening bell, the stock traded to as high as 120 pesos. At 0134 GMT, the volume reached 1.04 million shares.
The offering's price was slightly over 19 times Equitable's 1997 projected earnings but on par with industry leaders.
The bank has forecast that it will nearly double its earnings in 1997 to 2.011 billion pesos from 1.046 billion pesos a year ago.

Aside from the anticipation of sharp price gains in the IPO, investors had also been hoping Equitable's listing would usher back liquidity into the market, which has been in the doldrums on a lack of compelling news and Wall Street's recent tumbles.
